summary: Existing sketch generation methods often rely on image guidance and are largely limited to individual objects or simplified scenes, leaving text-guided complex scene sketching underexplored. We present SketchDirector, an agentic framework that mimics the human sketching workflow for automatic multi-concept scene sketching.
takeaways: Then, an agentic reasoning loop iteratively plans and executes their spatial arrangement, guided by self-evolving memory.
We present SketchDirector, an agentic framework that mimics the human sketching workflow for automatic multi-concept scene sketching.
Given a scene-level text prompt, SketchDirector first employs a large language model~(LLM) to decompose the scene into multiple draft assets, where each is represented by a set of Bézier curves.
